Sargent Electric is a leading specialty contractor focused on electrical, instrumentation, wireless, utility, and low voltage systems. Founded in Pittsburgh in 1907, we operate from 8 locations across the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, delivering projects nationwide for our strategic customers.

We support the breadth of client needs — from routine 24/7 service and emergency restoration to their largest and most complex projects. Our proven safety record, technical depth, and longstanding client relationships have made us a partner of choice for Fortune 500 companies, leading general contractors, and EPC contractors.

We are seeking a driven and experienced Project Manager to support our Renewables Division, reporting to our Pittsburgh, PA office. In this role, you will lead the full lifecycle of complex projects—ensuring safety, quality, financial performance, and client satisfaction—while working closely with field teams, leadership, and customers.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of high-impact projects in a growing segment of the business while helping drive operational excellence and long-term success. Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 30% of the time to support project execution and client requirements.

What You’ll Do Lead all phases of project execution , including safety, scheduling, budgeting, and client coordination Champion a best-in-class safety culture , partnering with field and safety teams to reduce risk and improve performance Manage project schedules, budgets, and financial outcomes to ensure predictable, profitable delivery Oversee construction execution , ensuring compliance with specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, engineers, and stakeholders , maintaining strong, professional relationships Direct and develop project teams , fostering accountability, collaboration, and professional growth Manage change orders, RFIs, and project risks , implementing strategies to protect company interests Monitor costs, invoices, A/P and A/R , and support forecasting and reporting activities Coordinate procurement, subcontractors, and equipment resources to support efficient project delivery Lead project closeout , including documentation, financial reconciliation, and contract compliance Ensure timely and accurate completion of project documentation and reporting requirements Support continuous improvement initiatives , including refining processes and operational best practices Contribute to business development efforts , including bidding and proposal support Mentor team members and support employee development and engagement initiatives Drive quality control and quality assurance across all phases of project execution What You’ll Bring Required: 3–5 years of leadership experience within the electrical construction industry , delivering projects on time and within budget Experience in renewables or power generation projects Strong understanding of project management, financial controls, and construction operations Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills , with the ability to work across diverse teams and stakeholders Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools Preferred: Experience with construction/project management systems such as Accubid Anywhere, Vista, Bluebeam, Procore, Plangrid, Navisworks, or similar tools Bachelor’s degree in engineering , Construction Management, Business Administration , or related field (or equivalent experience) Why Join Sargent Electric Established, growing company with a strong industry reputation Collaborative, team-driven environment with strong support across field and office teams Opportunity to directly impact project success and cost efficiency Competitive compensation based on experience Flexible work option: Remote role supporting the Pittsburgh office; Up to 30% travel based on project.

Equal Opportunity Employer Sargent Electric Company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Originally posted on Himalayas

Revolutionizing Islamic Finance with Blockchain Technology Are you ready to be part of a groundbreaking initiative that combines Islamic finance principles with cutting-edge blockchain technology? Look no further than Caiz – The First Islamic Ecosystem Built on Blockchain .

At Caiz , our mission is clear: to create a Fiqh compliant financial ecosystem that provides our community with fair and easy access to ethical financial products and services. We believe in empowering individuals to build a strong financial future while engaging in long-term economically beneficial behavior.

We are a passionate team reshaping finance, and we are expanding our dynamic workforce. Join us in a collaborative work environment focused on creating a fast and compliant money transfer structure. Why to Join Caiz ?

Innovative & Purpose-Driven : At Caiz , we combine advanced blockchain technology with the principles of Islamic finance to create an innovative and modern financial system. Join us to be part of a forward-thinking organization that is reshaping the future of finance.

Ethical Impact : As part of Caiz , you'll be working in an Organization that prioritizes ethics and integrity in all its operations, ensuring that every solution we offer aligns with the core values of fairness, transparency, and respect. Growth & Learning Opportunities : At Caiz , we value personal and professional growth.

You'll have the opportunity to learn, innovate, and grow within a dynamic, supportive environment, while contributing to the development of ethical financial solutions. Global Vision, Local Impact : Caiz is focused on creating an inclusive, sustainable financial system that empowers individuals globally.

You’ll be contributing to a company that has a positive impact on local communities and the global financial landscape. Collaborative Culture : We believe in teamwork and collaboration.

You'll work alongside passionate professionals who are committed to driving change in the crypto and blockchain space, working together to create an ethical financial future. Secure & Transparent Environment : We emphasize trust and security in all aspects of our operations.

As part of Caiz , you’ll be part of a transparent organization that values customer trust and ensures the highest security standards in the crypto space.crypto business developmen Tasks We are seeking a highly capable Project Manager to oversee and coordinate projects across all departments of the company.

This is a key leadership role that requires deep understanding of the crypto and blockchain industry , strong project management expertise, and the ability to drive execution in a dynamic, fast-evolving environment.

Responsibilities: Oversee and coordinate projects across all company departments to ensure alignment with Caiz Blockchain’s mission and strategic objectives. Lead execution of blockchain-related projects, from token ecosystem development to exchange relations, compliance initiatives, and community engagement.

Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones tailored for blockchain product launches and partnerships. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, marketers, compliance officers, and business development managers.

Ensure smooth execution of token launches, exchange listings, liquidity initiatives, and regulatory compliance requirements. Establish project management frameworks, reporting structures, and KPIs to measure success across all functions.

Identify risks unique to crypto markets (volatility, regulatory changes, liquidity challenges) and implement mitigation strategies. Act as the central point of communication between leadership and all departments. Report regularly to senior leadership on progress, performance, and critical issues.

Foster a culture of innovation, transparency, and accountability across the organization. Requirements Experience: 5–8 years of experience in project management, operations, or organizational leadership (experience in blockchain /Crypto required). Proven ability to manage multiple, large-scale projects across different departments.

Strong knowledge of blockchain ecosystems, tokenomics, exchange relations, and compliance in the crypto industry. Experience managing cross-functional teams in high-growth, innovative environments. Deep understanding of blockchain technology, crypto markets, and digital assets. Strong project management, planning, and execution skills.

Excellent leadership and cross-team coordination abilities. Strong communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Analytical mindset with ability to assess project risks in volatile crypto environments. Financial and resource management expertise with an understanding of token economics.

High adaptability in the rapidly changing blockchain/crypto industry. Level of studies: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or Technology (MBA or blockchain-specific certifications preferred).

Language Requirements: Fluent in English Benefits Benefits at Caiz : Competitive Financial Compensation : We offer financial benefits that reflect the value of your work and dedication. Work Flexibility : Enjoy the flexibility to work from home, the office, or even abroad.

Annual Holidays : Generous paid time off to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Relocation Assistance : We provide relocation support for employees moving to new locations. Professional Development : Opportunities for training, certifications, and career growth.

Employee Recognition : Programs to celebrate and reward your achievements and contributions. Inclusive & Collaborative Culture : A supportive and diverse work environment where your voice matters.

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion : We are committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity and promotes equality and inclusion for all employees. Don't miss this opportunity – apply now and be part of the Caiz revolution. Originally posted on Himalayas

Über uns
Die Agentur PHILIPP GmbH ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Technologie- und KI-Umsetzungsberatung für den Mittelstand. Wir entwickeln und implementieren KI-Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden funktionieren: von KI-Telefonie und Automatisierung über intelligente Dokumentenverarbeitung bis zu individuellen KI-Kollegen.
Wir machen aus KI keine Theorie. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung dafür, dass Lösungen sauber umgesetzt, integriert, getestet und vom Kunden wirklich genutzt werden.
Dafür suchen wir einen Projektmanager, der Kundenprojekte souverän steuert und gleichzeitig unsere interne Delivery mit klaren Prioritäten, Strukturen und Verbindlichkeit voranbringt.
Aufgaben
Kundenprojekte sicher ins Ziel bringen
Du steuerst KI-Projekte vom Kick-off bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe und Abnahme.
Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und hältst alle Beteiligten verbindlich auf dem Laufenden.
Du übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete für unsere Entwicklungs- und KI-Teams.
Du planst Projektphasen, Timings, Verantwortlichkeiten und Abhängigkeiten.
Du führst Kunden- und Projekttermine strukturiert, dokumentierst Entscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Punkte umgesetzt werden.
Du erkennst Risiken, fehlende Informationen oder Entscheidungsblockaden früh und führst sie aktiv zur Lösung.
Du begleitest Tests, Integration, Abnahme und Übergabe. Fertig ist ein Projekt erst, wenn es beim Kunden sauber funktioniert.
Delivery und Teamsteuerung weiterentwickeln
Du koordinierst Kapazitäten und Prioritäten über mehrere Kundenprojekte hinweg.
Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads dafür, dass die richtigen Themen zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Leuten liegen.
Du etablierst und pflegst klare Projektstandards: Projektstart, Anforderungen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Status, Tests, Abnahme und Dokumentation.
Du führst regelmäßige Projektstatus ein und machst Fortschritt, Risiken und notwendige Entscheidungen transparent.
Du hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Abläufe zu verbessern und aus Projekterfahrungen bessere Standards für die Zukunft zu machen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Operations, Teamleads und Entwicklung zusammen.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in Digital-, Software-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten.
Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich strukturieren und unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenbringen.
Du bist stark in Kundenkommunikation und trittst verbindlich, klar und professionell auf.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, denkst voraus und wartest nicht darauf, dass Probleme größer werden.
Du kannst Prioritäten setzen, auch wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig laufen.
Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge ausreichend gut, um mit Entwicklern, KI-Spezialisten und Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten. Du musst nicht selbst programmieren.
Erfahrung mit Tools wie Notion, Jira, ClickUp, Asana oder ähnlichen Projektmanagement-Systemen ist ein Plus.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, mindestens C1.
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort in Dingolfing und bei Kunden zu arbeiten. Remote-Arbeit ist möglich, aber nicht als reine Remote-Stelle gedacht.
Technische Erfahrung und Verständnis
Du hast bereits digitale, Software-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekte gesteuert und kennst typische technische Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Entscheidungswege.
Du verstehst die Grundlagen moderner KI-Lösungen, etwa LLMs, RAG, KI-Telefonie, Automatisierungen, APIs, Datenflüsse und Systemintegrationen.
Du kannst Anforderungen mit Kunden fachlich sauber klären und so aufbereiten, dass Entwickler daraus umsetzbare Arbeitspakete machen können.
Du erkennst, wenn für eine Umsetzung Daten, Zugänge, Schnittstellen, Datenschutzfreigaben oder Entscheidungen fehlen.
Du kannst technische Statusstände, Aufwandsschätzungen und Risiken nachvollziehen und für Kunden verständlich übersetzen.
Idealerweise hast du selbst Erfahrung mit n8n, REST-APIs, CRM- oder ERP-Anbindungen, Docker, Cloud-Systemen, Datenbanken oder Softwareentwicklung. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, solltest technische Teams aber wirksam steuern können.

Was wir dir bieten
Direkte Verantwortung für relevante KI-Projekte ab Tag 1.
Reale Mittelstandskunden statt interner Konzernpolitik oder endloser Präsentationen.
Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Operations und technischen Teamleads.
Die Möglichkeit, unsere Projektorganisation und Delivery-Standards aktiv mitzugestalten.
Remote-freundliche Arbeitsweise mit regelmäßiger Zusammenarbeit vor Ort.
Ein starkes Gehalt, passend zu deiner Erfahrung und Verantwortung.
Eine klare Entwicklungsperspektive in einem wachsenden KI-Unternehmen.
Unsere Haltung
Bei uns zählt nicht, ob etwas in einer Präsentation gut klingt. Es muss beim Kunden funktionieren und einen echten Unterschied machen.
Wirkung
Wir arbeiten nicht für Beschäftigung. Wir arbeiten für Ergebnisse, die für Kunden und ihr Unternehmen spürbar sind.
Durchziehen
Wir übernehmen Verantwortung und bleiben dran. Wenn es für den Projekterfolg nötig ist, gehen wir den entscheidenden Extra-Meter.
Verstehen
Wir hören genau zu, verstehen das Geschäft unserer Kunden und lösen nicht nur das technische, sondern das tatsächliche Problem.
Weiterdenken
Wir sehen mit, was als Nächstes gebraucht wird. Wir verbessern Abläufe, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
Besser werden
Wir haben einen hohen Anspruch an unsere Arbeit. Fehler nutzen wir, um daraus bessere Lösungen, bessere Zusammenarbeit und bessere Ergebnisse zu machen.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess
Kurzbewerbung mit Lebenslauf und kurzer Beschreibung deiner bisherigen Projektverantwortung
Erstgespräch zum gegenseitigen Kennenlernen
Praxisnahes Gespräch mit Geschäftsführung und Projektverantwortlichen
Angebot
Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt.
Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence.

We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers. Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated.

Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers. At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!

What We’re Looking For: AmeriSave is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Enterprise Technology & AI organization. This role sits at the intersection of technology and the business, driving complex, cross-functional initiatives that span in-house built systems, operational process change, and executive-level strategic priorities.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who has led both technology projects and business initiatives end to end, ideally within a well-known mortgage lending organization, and who is equally comfortable in a Gantt chart, a stakeholder steering committee, or a working session with engineers reviewing a build.

You will be the connective tissue between technology, operations, and leadership, translating strategy into executable plans and keeping delivery honest with data.

What You'll Do: End-to-End Project Ownership: Own the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional projects, from charter and requirements through execution, go-live, and post-launch measurement, spanning both technology builds and business/operational initiatives.

In-House Technology Delivery: Manage delivery of technology projects built in-house by internal engineering teams, partnering closely with product, engineering, and QA to sequence work, manage dependencies, and de-risk timelines for custom-built platforms and tools.

Planning & Tooling: Build and maintain detailed project plans, roadmaps, and Gantt charts using modern project management tooling; track milestones, critical path, resourcing, and risk in a way that is transparent to both delivery teams and executives.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead project teams composed of stakeholders across Technology, Operations, Capital Markets, Compliance, and Customer Service; align competing priorities, resolve blockers, and drive decisions to closure across departmental lines.

Executive Communication: Prepare and deliver clear, concise, and data-backed status updates, business cases, and executive readouts; comfortably present progress, risks, and trade-offs directly to senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.

Analytical Rigor: Use data to drive decisions: define success metrics up front, build reporting/dashboards to track project and post-launch performance, and use quantitative analysis to identify risk, scope creep, or underperformance early.

Process Improvement: Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the project portfolio and drive continuous improvement in how the organization plans, prioritizes, and delivers work.

Risk Management: Proactively surface, document, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving mitigation plans to protect timelines and business outcomes.

What You’ll Need: Deep Industry Experience: 7+ years of project management experience leading both technology and business initiatives, preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.

Technology & Business Project Management: Demonstrated success managing technology projects built in-house (custom platforms, internal tools, proprietary systems) in close partnership with engineering teams, in addition to managing business/operational projects.

Tools & Planning: Advanced proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Asana, or similar) and hands-on skill building and maintaining Gantt charts, roadmaps, and resourcing plans.

Cross-Functional Project Management: Proven track record managing initiatives across multiple departments and stakeholder groups, building consensus and driving alignment among teams with competing priorities.

Executive Communication: Polished, confident communicator who can distill complex, technical, or ambiguous initiatives into clear narratives for executive audiences, both in writing and in live presentations.

Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with data to define KPIs, build simple dashboards or reporting views, and use metrics (not just status colors) to tell the true story of a project's health. Certifications: PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification a plus; experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models is a requirement.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or a related field; MBA a plus. High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet.

Minimum speeds: 70/30 Mbps (basic), 200-300/35-70 Mbps (shared), 500-1,000/100+ Mbps (heavy use). **Please note that the compensation and benefit information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to applicable state and local laws on pay transparency.

It is estimated based on what a successful applicant in the relevant state might be paid. ** Compensation: The annual compensation for this position generally ranges from between $120,000 – $160,000 based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits: 401(k) Dental insurance Disability insurance Employee discounts Health insurance Life insurance Paid time off 12 paid holidays per year Paid training Referral program Vision insurance Supplemental pay types: ·Referral bonuses AmeriSave is an equal opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts, Case Management Modernization Program Office is seeking an experienced Information Technology Project Manager (Release Train Engineer) to join its team in the APMO Workstream. This position reports to the Chief, Product Portfolio Management.

The IT Project Manager serves as the daily technical program driver for the release train, maintaining integrated visibility to deliver progress, dependencies, Risks Actions Issues Dependencies (RAID) items, scope, procurement needs, resources, and budget signals across the value stream.

The duties of the position include, but are not limited to: Maintaining an integrated value stream delivery plan across build pods, aligning sprint and Program Increment (PI) execution to committed milestones and release items.

Tracking and managing cross-pod dependencies and handoffs ensuring blockers are surfaced early and routed through the correct escalation path. Maintaining and managing value stream RAID including intaking, prioritizing, mitigation planning, and leadership escalation.

Monitoring resource and budget signals at the value stream level and partnering with APMO and AO pod leads to address capacity gaps and forecast risks. Producing and maintaining program-ready execution artifacts, enabling transparent reporting, decision making support, and governance rhythms.

Analyzing, recommending, and implementing requirements, principles, and design models that satisfy the needs of the various system components. Maintaining product alignment oversight such as roadmaps, scopes, and sequencing management.

Providing integrated views of statuses, risks, dependencies, and near-term decisions report to APMO to consolidate pod and value stream execution progress. Driving cross-workstream alignment across solution, build, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive end-to-end delivery.

Facilitating decision-making forums to ensure timely resolution of ambiguities and maintaining structured decision logs and escalation pathways across the value streams. Leading increment (PI) planning readiness and alignment to ensure synchronization between roadmap, scope, and execution timelines.

Coordinating with vendors to establish onboarding standards and ensure adherence to program frameworks and delivery expectations. Defining and maintaining value stream level metrics and dashboards to track delivery, health, risks, and execution performance.

Spearheading stakeholder engagement through proactive communication to ensure alignment across technical and non-technical audiences. Contributing to framework and process maturity including standardization of tools (e.g. Jira structures), templates, and operating rhythms.

Supporting capacity planning and resource alignment across pods/value streams to meet roadmap priorities. Facilitating cross-team tradeoff discussions to resolve competing priorities and maintaining momentum.
Applicants must have demonstrated experience as listed below. This requirement is according to the AO Classification, Compensation, and Recruitment Systems which include interpretive guidance and reference to the OPM Operating Manual for Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions.

Specialized Experience: Applicants must have at least one full year (52 weeks) of specialized experience which is in or directly related to the line of work of this position.

Specialized experience must demonstrate experience in ALL areas defined below: Serving as a technical program manager or release train engineer in a scaled, multi-team agile environment supporting Program Increment (PI) planning and releasing trains.

Managing integrated delivery across multiple pods, including dependency orchestration, Risks Actions Issues Dependencies (RAID) discipline, and executive-ready status narratives. Using modern engineering delivery practices to translate technical constraints into delivery implications and sequencing decisions.

· Support forecasting and financial reporting activities.

· Ensure testing scenarios reflect accurate transaction lifecycles and edge cases across both cloud and on-premises systems.
Risk, Issue & Change Management

· Log and track risks, issues, and action items.

· Facilitate mitigation discussions and escalate items when needed.

· Identify risks related to process breakdowns, incorrect accounting, or integration gaps across transaction flows, including legacy system constraints.

· Support the change control process and ensure proper documentation of out-of-scope work.

Governance & Reporting

· Help improve post-go-live handoff processes and lessons learned documentation.

As the Program Manager New Ship Design you will have the following duties: Responsible for overseeing the technology development, design and construction of new design nuclear propulsion plants for the Navy's next generation strategic deterrent COLUMBIA Class and the Navy's next generation attack submarine, SSN(X) design.

Serves as a principal advisor to the Deputy Administrator for Naval Reactors, on policy issues affecting major program planning, budget and priority objectives. Advises on a wide variety of important complex and difficult problems affecting new design nuclear powered ships.

Represents the Deputy Administrator for Naval Reactors on day-to-day issues and in meetings with top level Navy, Department of Defense, Department of Energy, General Accounting Office, Office of Management and Budget, Congressional and industry officials on matters associated with new design submarine nuclear propulsion plants.

Provides overall program direction to Naval Reactors senior management and staff and to senior management at private and naval shipyards and Naval Reactors laboratories and procurement prime contractors for achieving program goals.

Coordinates the efforts of the numerous vendors and contractor design groups in the program to ensure that sources of supply of highly specialized equipment are developed, safety and quality are maintained at each plant, and a well-coordinated system exists which provides for a timely flow of design data and components to shipyards.

## *Introduction* ##
Pour notre secteur **Industrialisation & Production Ebauches**, nous recherchons un **Manager Process (H/F)** dont la mission principale sera d'intervenir dès la conception du produit pour garantir le respect des préconisations, définir et mettre à jour les standards Produit-Process, piloter le cycle de vie des produits jusqu'à leur qualification industrielle, traiter les demandes de modification (DMPP), et porter l'amélioration continue des Process en lien avec la Production et l'Industrialisation.
## *Responsabilités* ##
* Intervenir dès la phase de définition du produit lors du co-design pour garantir le respect des préconisations et identifier les potentiels écarts et impacts associés
* Définir et mettre à jour les préconisations Produit-Process afin de garantir un produit homogène entre les différents calibres
* Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des produits, du développement des nouveaux produits jusqu'à leur fin de cycle de vie, en validant notamment le passage en série et la qualification industrielle
* Analyser, valider, prioriser et piloter le suivi des demandes de modification de produits (DMPP)
* Proposer et piloter des actions d'amélioration continue des Process de Production, en collaboration avec la Production et l'Industrialisation
## *Profil* ##
* Diplôme d-ingénieur HES, ou équivalent en mécanique ou microtechnique
* Connaissance du métier d-industrialisation, de la gestion de projets et des outils associés
* Maîtrise des process de production (horloger)

s.h: 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary
s.t:
As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.
This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform .
You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.
Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:
Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?
Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?
Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?
Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution .
🚀 What you'll own
Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.
Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.
Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.
Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.
Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.
Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.
Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.
Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.
Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.
Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.
Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

s.h: Review and interpret customer technical documentation including
s.t:
Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
Network and communications diagrams
Site and asset specifications
PPC and controller documentation
Modbus register maps
IP addressing and network information
Functional Design Specifications
Metering and telemetry information

Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.
Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.
Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.
Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.
Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:
Gateway installation and connectivity
Operational acceptance testing
Kraken market and service testing
Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.
Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.
Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

## Job Description ##
As Relationship Manager within the EAM Business Line, you are responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of External Asset Managers and their underlying business relationships.
You act as the primary point of contact for your clients, ensuring a high level of service, identifying business opportunities and coordinating internally to provide an efficient and professional client experience.
The role combines relationship management, commercial development, client governance and close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

* Independently manage and develop a portfolio of EAM clients.
* Act as the main point of contact for day-to-day relationship and business matters.
* Build strong and sustainable relationships with External Asset Managers and key decision makers.
* Understand clients' business models, needs and future development potential.
* Identify opportunities to deepen existing relationships through additional assets, trading activity, products and services.
* Monitor the business contribution and potential of assigned client relationships and take appropriate action where expectations are not met.
* Conduct regular client meetings and ensure relevant information and follow-up actions are properly documented.
* Coordinate client onboarding, account openings and lifecycle activities together with Support, BRM, Compliance and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure timely completion of client file reviews and other regulatory or governance requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate pricing proposals, special conditions and commercial offers in line with the applicable approval framework.
* Proactively identify and escalate client, operational, financial or reputational risks. (Key Risk Indicators)
* Handle client issues and escalations and coordinate appropriate solutions internally.
* Work closely with Business Development, Trading, Product, Operations and other teams to provide an integrated Institutional service.
* Contribute to Business Line initiatives, client portfolio reviews and continuous improvement of the EAM offering.

* Several years of experience in Relationship Management, Client Advisory or a comparable role within banking or financial services.
* Good understanding of the External Asset Manager / Independent Wealth Management environment.
* Knowledge of securities, trading, custody, FX and institutional banking services.
* Strong client orientation combined with a commercial mindset.
* Ability to independently manage a client portfolio and prioritise multiple requests.
* Good understanding of KYC, AML and client governance requirements.
* Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* Proactive, accountable and comfortable working across different teams and locations.
* French: fluent or native-level required - English: professional working proficiency - required
* German: strong advantage
